name: Aperio Exchange (EWS)
author: Aperio Contributors
description: Bundled Exchange Web Services adapter for on-premise Exchange and Exchange-alike servers (Kerio Connect, Zimbra-with-EWS).

en.account.action.discover.hint: Ask Microsoft Autodiscover for the EWS endpoint based on your e-mail address. Requires the e-mail and password fields above to be filled in.
en.account.action.discover.label: Discover URL
en.account.action.discover.needs_email: Please enter your e-mail address before running Discover — autodiscover uses it to figure out which server to ask.
en.account.action.discover.needs_password: Please enter your password before running Discover — Microsoft's autodiscover endpoint requires Basic auth.
en.account.endpoint.hint: The Exchange Web Services SOAP endpoint your server admin gave you. Always ends in "/EWS/Exchange.asmx". If you don't know the URL, fill in the e-mail + password fields below and press "Discover URL" — Aperio will ask Microsoft Autodiscover for you.
en.account.endpoint.label: EWS endpoint URL
en.account.password.hint: The password of your Exchange mailbox. EWS authenticates with HTTP Basic on every request; the password is stored only in your operating system's credential store.
en.account.password.label: Password
en.account.username.hint: Usually your full email address, but some servers want DOMAIN\username. Ask your admin if unsure.
en.account.username.label: Username

de.account.action.discover.hint: Microsoft Autodiscover anhand der E-Mail-Adresse nach der EWS-Endpunkt-URL fragen. Setzt voraus, dass E-Mail und Passwort oben ausgefüllt sind.
de.account.action.discover.label: URL automatisch suchen
de.account.action.discover.needs_email: Bitte zuerst die E-Mail-Adresse eintragen — Autodiscover braucht sie, um den richtigen Server zu finden.
de.account.action.discover.needs_password: Bitte zuerst das Passwort eintragen — der Autodiscover-Endpunkt fordert Basic-Auth.
de.account.endpoint.hint: Die SOAP-URL der Exchange Web Services, die dein Admin dir genannt hat. Endet immer auf „/EWS/Exchange.asmx". Wenn du die URL nicht kennst: trage E-Mail und Passwort unten ein und drücke „URL automatisch suchen" — Aperio fragt für dich bei Microsoft Autodiscover nach.
de.account.endpoint.label: EWS-Endpunkt-URL
de.account.password.hint: Das Passwort deines Exchange-Postfachs. EWS meldet sich bei jeder Anfrage per HTTP-Basic an; das Passwort wird nur im Anmeldeinformations-Manager des Betriebssystems gespeichert.
de.account.password.label: Passwort
de.account.username.hint: Meist deine vollständige E-Mail-Adresse, manche Server wollen aber DOMAIN\Benutzername. Bei Unsicherheit den Admin fragen.
de.account.username.label: Benutzername
